newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes strike in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes strike in Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes hit Hizbollah targets in south Lebanon on Sunday, security sources said.

Two Israeli fighter jets fired two rockets into the hills of Jabal ad-Dahr Daidaba southwest of the Bekaa Valley, where Hizbollah guerrillas killed three Israeli soldiers and wounded seven on Thursday, they said.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air raid -- the fifth into Lebanon in three days and the 35th in 1997.
Simultaneously, Israeli artillerymen rocketed the area and a pilotless reconnaissance aircraft was seen in the air.
